verdict.rationale: Qdrant's architecture is fundamentally API-first (REST/gRPC API with clients in Python, JS, Go, Rust, etc.) and the Web UI is described by users as a secondary, weaker component ('UI could be better'), implying the UI is a thin layer over the same API rather than exposing exclusive functionality. However, there is no explicit documentation asserting full UI/API parity, and no OpenAPI spec was found publicly (probe returned 404s), making it hard to verify completeness. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement/documentation, a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec confirming full API surface, and any independent audit of UI-only features.
